```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
```

----------------------------------------------------------------------
Plot function - Median of ratios counts
- Some info [https://hbctraining.github.io/DGE_workshop/lessons/02_DGE_count_normalization.html]
- DESeq2’s median of ratios for comparison of genes BETWEEN samples (https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/DESeq2/versions/1.12.3/topics/estimateSizeFactors)
- Adjusts for differences in sequencing depth & RNA composition (but not for length, as we compare genes of same length between groups)
- Compare gene expression between Expi and Expi-ULK1-KO
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Plot median of ratios normalized counts for ADDON genes
# Get df for gene addon of interest
```{r}
get_addon_df <- function(data, metadata, genes, prot_name) {
  df_addon <- data %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -X, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
    left_join(metadata, by = "sample") %>%
    filter(X %in% genes) %>%
    filter(short_name %in% c(paste0("Expi_", prot_name), paste0("Vulko_", prot_name))) %>%
    dplyr::select(X, cell_type, case, expression)
  
  return(df_addon)
}
```


```{r}
data <- read.csv("../results/DE/estFactors_normalized_counts.csv")
metadata <- read.table("../data/meta/metadata.txt", header = TRUE)

# Get expression of addon genes
GPR75_df <- get_addon_df(data, metadata, c("GPR75_addon"), c("GPR75"))
GIPR_df <- get_addon_df(data, metadata, c("GIPR_addon"), c("GIPR"))
hP2X3_df <- get_addon_df(data, metadata, c("hP2X3_addon"), c("hP2X3"))

# Merge addon dfs to plot together
df_merged <- rbind(GPR75_df, GIPR_df, hP2X3_df)

# Get stats on addons
df_stats <- df_merged %>%
    group_by(X, cell_type) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_expression = mean(expression),
      sd_expression = sd(expression),
      .groups = "drop")

df_stats
```

Gene count plot
```{r}
condition_colors <- c("Expi" = "#9bd1ae", "Vulko" = "#98b5eb")
condition_labels <- c("Expi" = "Expi", "Vulko" = "Expi-ULK1-KO")

gene_count_plot <- ggplot(df_stats,
       aes(x = factor(X),
           y = mean_expression,
           group = cell_type,
           fill = cell_type)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = position_dodge(width=0.9),
           width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_expression - sd_expression, ymax = mean_expression + sd_expression),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25) +
    geom_point(data = df_merged,
             aes(x = factor(X), y = expression, fill = cell_type, group = cell_type),
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.9, seed = 1),
             color = "black", size = 1) +
    labs(x = "", y = "Counts (median of ratios norm)",
         fill = "Cell line") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = condition_colors,
                    labels = condition_labels) +
    ylim(0, 3000000) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5), 
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16), 
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 19),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 19),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 16)
      )
  
pdf("../results/count_plots/med_of_ratios/gene_count_addon_20260825.pdf", width=6, height = 5)
print(gene_count_plot)
dev.off()
```
